title: Projective Origin of the Spin Hydrodynamic Attractor and Its Resurgent Repellor
summary: We investigate the projective and resurgent structure of a spin hydrodynamic attractor in Bjorken expansion. We show that the nonlinear spin solution family is determined by the projective classes of the two dimensional linear solution space, with the attractor and repellor corresponding to two distinguished projective directions and the linear modes ratio generating the full one-parameter transseries tower.
